public_rationale: The released training pipeline requires substantial resources, but that does not settle the effort needed to adapt Cicero to a changed board or rules. The original README also permits repeating reinforcement learning from existing checkpoints without new external game data. That limits a blanket reading of the claim, but does not demonstrate easy adaptation. The located evidence therefore establishes neither support nor contradiction for the contextual claim.
limitations: Original-game retraining and adaptation to a new game variant are different tests.
Substantial compute requirements do not by themselves establish substantial new human labor.
The absence of a located adaptation experiment is not proof that an easy method was impossible.
